name: Sticky Soy-Glazed Steak Tacos with Spicy Broccoli Slaw & Peanuts

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel and mince ginger; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and garlic to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, about 1 minute.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper to the pan and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened and reduced by half, 3-4 minutes. Remove glaze from the heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce
salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium carrot
½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate along with half the glaze, and turn to coat. Loosely cover with foil.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; top with steak, remaining glaze, slaw, and peanuts. Enjoy!
